corrections_and_limits: KAAS CP932 example corrected: bytes 83 49 encode the character; the same bytes interpreted as little-endian u16 have value 0x4983, not 0x8349. Actual file packing still requires evidence
ISA memo 0x30-byte records kept distinct from GARbro 0x60 and 0x20 record paths; decrypt helper existence does not establish invocation
Fudegaki additive decryption implies key = plaintext - ciphertext modulo 256, with absolute member offset phase
Malie numbered parts 0 through 6 treated as seven logical parts rather than a six-part universal layout
FDT2 bitwise-complemented code values do not preserve numeric sort order; comparator and packing must be checked
Absolute references do not require truncation if proven relocation is available; variable lengths still require capacity and loader checks
No implicit empty-translation fallback, first-wins shared-name writes, approximate control restoration, automatic Ruby removal or wait rewriting
CP932 includes single-byte characters; even line width is format-dependent. Kinsoku, indentation and line limits are explicit layout parameters
No blanket all-opcode default width, heuristic resynchronization or declaration of unsupported raw regions as fully parsed code
Thresholds, bitmap dimensions and protected-region coordinates remain diagnostic or dialect candidates, not universal engine properties
Translation JSON retains the existing name/names/message contract with identity and original bytes in metadata; id/pre_jp are not added as mandatory fields
No new runtime parser, writer, engine registration, private keys, fonts, binaries or game-specific execution reports
